name: cheer_joi_v3
summary: Cheerleader JOI, third pass, 2 minutes. Every key is his photo with the SAME empty room put behind it (story_keys room_empty arm), so the room never morphs between photos. Legs chain: each starts on the previous leg's last frame and lands on a key photo; a free leg (no end) is always followed by one that lands, so her face is re-pinned at least every 10 s. 81 frames at 16 fps per leg, colour ramped. Jeremy, 2026-10-30: 'I cannot have the facial drift. That is unacceptable.'
suffix: one continuous shot, smooth natural motion, she moves slowly and gently, small smooth movements
negative: fast motion, motion blur, camera cut, scene change, morphing, face change, different person
